name: broskees/lua-to-php-transpiler
description: Transpiles Lua 5.4 to PHP that behaves exactly like Lua 5.4.9, and runs sandboxed Lua inside PHP applications.

suggest.ext-opcache: Caches and optimizes the generated PHP; its tracing JIT runs it 1.3 to 2 times faster
suggest.ext-posix: Error texts (strerror) of the host's C library; without it, glibc's texts
suggest.ext-pcntl: Exit statuses of io.popen and os.execute by waitpid; without it, by polling

scripts-descriptions.test: Runs the unit and differential tests (needs lua5.4 and luac5.4 5.4.9).
scripts-descriptions.lint: Checks the code style (PSR-12) with PHP_CodeSniffer.
